title: West Chester Area schools land 19th in the region in Niche's 2027 rankings
summary: Niche's new district rankings place the West Chester Area School District 19th in Greater Philadelphia and 498th nationally. Six Chester County districts made the region's top 25, led by Tredyffrin-Easttown at No. 1.

title: West Chester Green Team pushes to bring back the stars over Chester County
summary: The Green Team's Dark Skies Committee is urging towns to dim, warm and re-aim outdoor lighting, helped shape a state bill to curb light pollution on state properties, and wants the county to seek Dark Sky Place certification.

title: West Chester becomes Pennsylvania's newest Bird Town
summary: Bird Town Pennsylvania made the borough's designation official at a Borough Hall ceremony, crediting its pesticide-free parks and growing number of rain and pollinator gardens. Volunteers, two WCU professors and the borough's sustainability director led the push, and the borough plans bird-friendly landscaping next.

title: Chester County's measles outbreak now ranks among the nation's worst
summary: With 83 confirmed cases, Chester County has more measles infections than any of 41 other states, trailing only Lancaster and Mifflin within Pennsylvania. Health officials are urging residents to check their MMR immunity, and a blood titer test works for anyone without vaccination records.

title: WCU's Dance for HER benefit concert returns Oct. 25
summary: West Chester University's dance company and dance team host the fifth annual show at Asplundh Concert Hall, with Chester County studios performing to raise money for West Chester-based Unite for HER. This year guests can bring a photo or memento for a tribute board honoring people affected by breast and ovarian cancer.

title: West Chester biotech MTTI wins $3.17M federal grant for a lung cancer drug
summary: Molecular Targeting Technologies received a five-year National Cancer Institute grant to move its experimental radiopharmaceutical Lu-EBRGD toward clinical trials in non-small cell lung cancer.

title: Propane transfer facility cleared for Phoenixville Pike in West Goshen
summary: A 1.5-acre lot at Phoenixville Pike and Saunders Lane is set to become an above-ground propane transfer site with two 30,000-gallon tanks. West Goshen's zoning officer says the plans comply with township rules.

title: West Chester police grow beards for five local charities
summary: West Chester officers have relaxed grooming rules for three months to raise money for Unite for Her, the West Chester Food Cupboard and three other local causes. Last year's regional version of the fundraiser brought in more than $50,000.

title: Phineas Gage marks 10 years downtown with an anniversary weekend
summary: The West Chester restaurant is celebrating a decade in the borough with giveaways, discounts and celebratory drinks. Nearby Gemelli Gelato is also marking 12 years on Market Street.

title: Henderson sophomore repeats as Ches-Mont National tennis champ
summary: Erika Dunwoody beat Downingtown East's Mahi Patel 6-1, 7-5 to defend her Ches-Mont League National Division girls singles title. She moves on to the district championships next.
